canonical.title: A first-visit guide to Sandakan & Sepilok

siblings.title: Eat — Sandakan & Sepilok: Where Story Beats Star Count
siblings.summary: A character-first eating map — stilt-village seafood, 'Little Hong Kong' kopitiams, the accidental UFO tart, colonial high tea, and Sepilok jungle kitchens.

siblings.title: Sleep — Sandakan & Sepilok: character stays from jungle lodges to river camps
siblings.summary: Where to base a first Borneo trip: Sepilok jungle lodges, Kinabatangan river camps, a turtle-island chalet and Sandakan heritage stays — chosen for character.

siblings.title: Do — Sandakan & Sepilok: wildlife, river, caves & history
siblings.summary: The accessible, semi-adventurous playbook: Sepilok's wildlife trio, the Kinabatangan cruise, caves, turtles and the town's WWII history.

siblings.title: See — Sandakan & Sepilok: heritage icons, wildlife & coast
siblings.summary: The colonial Heritage Trail, the Death March memorial, Sepilok's wildlife icons, and the wild Kinabatangan, with booking lead times and best weather window.

siblings.title: Offbeat Sandakan & Sepilok: ghosts, croquet, cow-dung tarts & a 2-million-bat exodus
siblings.summary: The quirky layer — bombed-flat 'Little Hong Kong', a leper-island POW escape, a colonial croquet lawn, cow-dung-shaped tarts, and a bat exodus.

siblings.title: Culture in Sandakan & Sepilok: museums, temples, markets & festivals (with dates)
siblings.summary: Colonial-port culture decoded: museums, Chinese temples, the war memorial, water-village markets and a full festival calendar with 2026 dates.

siblings.title: Around & day-trips: Sandakan & Sepilok logistics
siblings.summary: Practical hops in, out and around Sandakan/Sepilok plus a costed day-trip orbit for a first Borneo visit.

sources.title: Sepilok Orangutan Rehabilitation Centre — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: The Sepilok orangutan rehabilitation centre is a managed feeding site at the Batu 14 gate.

sources.title: Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre
sources.claim: The Bornean Sun Bear centre sits next door to the orangutan centre.

sources.title: Rainforest Discovery Centre — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: The Rainforest Discovery Centre offers a canopy walk and birding at Sepilok.

sources.title: Kinabatangan River Cruise — Girl on a Zebra
sources.claim: Dawn and night Kinabatangan cruises give Borneo's best-odds wildlife watching and need an overnight.

sources.title: Where to stay on the Kinabatangan — Girl on a Zebra
sources.claim: Kinabatangan overnight packages and river lodges are the big-ticket spend.

sources.title: Gomantong Cave — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: Gomantong Caves offer a bat-and-swiftlet spectacle en route to the river.

sources.title: Selingan Turtle Island
sources.claim: Selingan Turtle Island offers an overnight with ~50 permits/night and peak nesting Aug–Sep.

sources.title: Labuk Bay Proboscis Monkey Sanctuary — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: Labuk Bay is a cliff-top managed feeding site for proboscis monkeys.

sources.title: Sandakan Memorial Park — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Sandakan Memorial Park commemorates the WWII Death March.

sources.title: Sandakan Heritage Trail — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: The Heritage Trail links the 100 Steps, St Michael's and Agnes Keith House.

sources.title: Agnes Keith House — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: Agnes Keith House tells the 'Land Below the Wind' story.

sources.title: Sandakan best time to visit — Sabah Guide
sources.claim: East-coast Sabah is best Mar–Sep; the NE monsoon Nov–Jan can cancel island boats.

sources.title: AirAsia BKI → SDK flights
sources.claim: The BKI→Sandakan flight is 45 minutes versus a 6-hour mountain bus.

sources.title: Sandakan airport to Sepilok — Sabah Tourism
sources.claim: Use local bus #14 or a lodge transfer for the 25 km airport–Sepilok hop; Grab is thin.

sources.title: Sandakan → Kuala Lumpur flights — Airpaz
sources.claim: Fly onward SDK→KL via KK for the next leg.

sources.title: Kaamatan — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Kaamatan (Harvest Festival) falls 30–31 May 2026 but peaks near Kota Kinabalu.

sources.title: English Tea House & Restaurant Sandakan
sources.claim: The English Tea House offers colonial high tea and sunset views.

sources.title: Sandakan UFO Tart — Daniel Food Diary
sources.claim: The accidental 'UFO tart' is a Sandakan dessert specialty.

sources.title: The Sea Garden, Sim Sim — Harbour Mall Sandakan
sources.claim: Charcoal seafood dinners are served out in the Sim Sim stilt village.

sources.title: Puu Jih Shih Temple — Wikipedia
sources.claim: The hilltop Puu Jih Shih Temple offers a harbour view.

sources.title: Pulau Berhala — 1Stop Borneo Guide
sources.claim: Pulau Berhala carries leper-colony and POW-escape history as a day-trip.

sources.title: Borneo Nature Lodge
sources.claim: A Kinabatangan river lodge for the overnight cruise base.

sources.title: Sepilok Nature Resort
sources.claim: A Sepilok jungle lodge for the wildlife days.
